action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that Apache XML Security for Java incorrectly passed a
configuration property when creating specific key elements. An attacker
could possibly use this issue to abuse an XPath Transform and extract
sensitive information. After this update, file: and http: URIs are only
dereferenced when the org.apache.xml.security.allowUnsafeResourceResolving
property is set.
isummary: Apache XML Security for Java could be made to expose sensitive information.
title: Apache XML Security for Java vulnerability
